type.description: The type id of the response

kind.description: The kind of instance, server, cluster or super-cluster

cluster.description: The cluster the server is in

port.description: The client port, or the port of the client proxy for an instance created with toxics

ports.description: Further ports by listener name, such as cluster and trace

advertise.description: The configured client_advertise host, empty when the node advertises nothing

trace_url.description: The URL of the server's capture proxy, set client-side from the trace port

version.description: The server version the node runs, set by status only

ca_pem.description: The PEM of the generated CA

client_cert_pem.description: The PEM of the issued client cert, for mutual TLS only

client_key_pem.description: The PEM of the issued client key, for mutual TLS only

tls.description: The cert material to dial the instance over TLS, absent without TLS

name.description: The link's name, route:<node>-><node>, gateway:<cluster>-><node> or client:<node>

kind.description: The link's kind, route, gateway or client

from.description: The node that dials through a route proxy, or the cluster whose nodes dial through a gateway proxy, empty for a client proxy

to.description: The node the proxy forwards to

proxy.description: The host:port the nodes or clients dial the proxy on

upstream.description: The host:port the proxy forwards to

links.description: The proxied links of an instance created with toxics, its routes, then its gateways, then its client proxies
